Mrs. H McClenaghanExecutive Headteacher
Mrs A ArgireHeadteacher
OUR ETHOS
Our ethos is to create a federation of schools where children succeed and are proud of their achievements. We strive to actively promote British values and prepare our children to become role models, thus preparing them for life in modern Britain. To do this, we create a respectful, inclusive atmosphere that is welcoming, fun, friendly and safe. We are a federation that nurtures curiosity and creativity through an inspiring, challenging and engaging curriculum, where learning is at the heart of all that we do. Our children learn to become resilient and self-assured in an environment where success is celebrated.Our ethos is delivered through these aims for our children:
Through the aims of the Federation, we actively promote lifelong learning whilst ensuring the children respect one another, enjoy their school experiences and achieve their personal best.
Growing Together, Learning Forever!
CROWLANDS PRIMARY SCHOOL

Welcome to our Reception
CLICK HERE for a guide on What to expect in the Early Years Foundation Stage
Click here for a trip around our Nursery and Reception
Starting Reception is a definition of the skills children need when they start Reception. Developed by the early years sector and backed by Government, it focuses on the practical skills that help children settle into school, build relationships and make the most of their learning from day one.
The definition helps create a shared understanding between schools, early years settings and families about the skills children can practise before they start Reception.
For more information click here.
To help families put these skills into practice, we've created two new free resources:
A Starting Reception reward chart Click here
A pack of simple activity ideas for families Click here
The activities are linked directly to the Starting Reception definition and focus on everyday skills such as getting dressed independently, following simple instructions and talking about feelings and needs.
They are designed to make practising school readiness skills simple, fun and achievable at home over the summer.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Headteacher | Crowlands Primary School
pageCache.text:
Crowlands Primary School
WELCOME TO OUR SCHOOL!
At Crowlands Primary School, we pride ourselves on fostering a nurturing and inclusive environment where every child is encouraged to achieve their full potential. Our dedicated staff work tirelessly to ensure that each student feels valued, supported and inspired to succeed, both academically and personally. We are committed to delivering high-quality education and we strive to create a vibrant learning experience that cultivates curiosity, creativity and critical thinking.
As you and your child settle into school life, we understand that joining a new school can feel like a big step, both for students and families. Please know that we are here to support you every step of the way. If you have any questions or concerns, our teachers, administrative staff and senior leaders are always available to assist you. We also encourage you to participate in school activities and events, as this is a wonderful way to become involved in the community and to get to know other families.
Our school values the strong partnership between home and school and we believe that working together is key to ensuring your child’s success. Communication will be an important part of this collaboration and we will keep you informed of key dates, important announcements and your child’s progress throughout the year.
Once again, thank you for choosing Crowlands Primary School and we look forward to watching your child achieve their personal best!
Mrs S Clark - Headteacher

Crowlands Primary School
Collective Worship at Crowlands Primary School
By Law, all maintained schools must provide religious education and daily collective worship for all students.
Collective Worship aims to promote spiritual, moral and cultural development.
It is compulsory for all schools to perform an act of collective worship daily unless students ask for an exemption. At Crowlands it takes place in our daily school assemblies and classes.
Crowlands encourage children to reflect upon their own beliefs while taking part and this is built on our values of PROUD.

Crowlands Primary School
Admissions
Crowlands Primary School can offer both 15 hours and 30 hours provison.
For admissions to the Nursery and further information please contact our school officeon 01708 743402.
Admission to KS1 (Infants) and KS2 (Junior)
Havering Council (the Local Authority) is the admission authority for all community schools in the London Borough of Havering. This means that it is the Council’s responsibility to set the admissions criteria and make the decisions as to which pupils are admitted to this school.
The admission arrangements can be viewed on the following page:
https://www.havering.gov.uk/info/20008/school_admissions/482/school_admissions_arrangements_and_statistics
Applications for children to start Reception in September must be made via your home Local Authority. For parents that live in Havering this website is www.eadmissions.org.uk
In Year Admissions Process
Information for parents wishing to transfer their child to this school from another school (In Year Applications) can be found here www.havering.gov.uk/admissions/inyear.
If your child has not been offered a school place following an in-year application, you have the legal right to appeal this decision to an Independent Appeal Panel.
In Havering, we utilise an external company to facilitate all school appeals.
This company is responsible for clerking, timetabling, and arranging independent panels, ensuring the appeals process is entirely independent of both the school and the Local Authority, providing a fair and impartial review.
In line with the School Admission Appeals Code 2022, all admission appeals will be held online.
This approach has been chosen by the admission authority and appeal panels based on positive feedback from previous online hearings.
For further information regarding the appeals process please click on the link below.
www.havering.gov.uk/admissions/appeal
